The '''2010 Dominican Republic census''' is the ninth Dominican Republic national census, raised from 1–7 December 2010, during the presidency of [[Leonel Fernández]]. This census collected information respect on sex, occupation, age, fertility, marital status, nationality, literacy, ability to vote, and housing. The Dominican Republic's next census took place in [[2022 Dominican Republic Census|2022]].
